observations: Photo 0 shows a black and silver 4-burner gas cooker with an oven door open, revealing a single oven rack and interior.
The top surface has four burners with black grates and silver centers; the oven door has a glass window with a silver frame.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from a slightly different angle, with the oven door closed, revealing a black handle and a silver-framed glass window.
The unit appears to be in a storage or workshop environment, with plastic wrapping on the base and a lock visible in the background.
There is visible wear and scratches on the top surface and sides of the unit.
No brand or model name is visible on the unit in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Standing Gas Cooker with Oven and grill' — the grill is not visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Used Standing Gas Cooker with Oven and grill
claims.evidence: The grill is not visible in either photo. The oven is confirmed. The 'standing' nature is supported by the unit's height and design, but the grill claim cannot be verified from the photos.

risks.risk: The grill may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo showing the grill area with the oven door open, or a close-up of the grill burner if present.

risks.risk: The unit may not work (e.g., gas leaks, faulty burners, oven malfunction).
risks.proof: A video showing the unit lit with all burners and oven operating, or a close-up of the gas connections and valves.

risks.risk: The unit may have internal damage or corrosion not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the oven interior, including the heating elements and walls, and the gas connections.

proof_requests: Photo of the grill area with the oven door open.
Video showing the unit lit with all burners and oven operating.
Close-up of the oven interior and gas connections.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
